title: The night passes
introduction: This chapter starts with Kaikeyi's entreaties to the king followed by Dasaratha disowning her as wife. The night passes and Sumantra comes to wake up the King. Ordered by Kaikeyi to bring Sri Rama to the king, he goes to Sri Rama to fetch Him.
closing: || इत्यार्शे स्रीमद्रामायने आदिकाव्ये अयोध्यकान्दे चतुर्दशः सर्गः ||
Thus completes fourteenth chapter of Ayodhya kanda in Srimad Ramayana , the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
पुत्र शोक अर्दितम् पापा विसम्ज्ञम् पतितम् भुवि |
विवेष्टमानम् उदीक्ष्य सा ऐक्ष्वाकम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
putra śoka arditam pāpā visamGYam patitam bhuvi |
viveṣṭamānam udīkṣya sā aikṣvākam idam abravīt
verses.translation: That wicked woman spoke these words to Dasaratha, tormented as he was by the anguish for his son and who was unconscious, tossing about on the floor.

glosses.meaning: to Dasaratha who was born in Ikshvaaku dynasty
tormented by the anguish for his son

verses.devanagari:
पापम् क्ऱ्त्वा इव किम् इदम् मम संश्रुत्य संश्रवम् |
शेषे क्षिति तले सन्नः स्थित्याम् स्थातुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
pāpam kRtvā iva kim idam mama saṃśrutya saṃśravam |
śeṣe kṣiti tale sannaḥ sthityām sthātum tvam arhasi
verses.translation: "What is this? After hearing the promise given to me, you are lying on the floor dejected as though you had committed a great sin. You ought to keep yourself within bounds of ethics".

glosses.itrans: though you had perpetrated a sithtyaam
glosses.iast: though you had perpetrated a sithtyām
glosses.devanagari: थोउघ् योउ हद् पेर्पेत्रतेद् अ सिथ्त्यां

verses.devanagari:
आहुः सत्यम् हि परमम् धर्मम् धर्मविदो जनाः |
सत्यम् आश्रित्य हि मया त्वम् च धर्मम् प्रचोदितः
verses.iast:
āhuḥ satyam hi paramam dharmam dharmavido janāḥ |
satyam āśritya hi mayā tvam ca dharmam pracoditaḥ
verses.translation: "People who know what is right, indeed speak of truthfulness as highest virtue. I too have taken refuge in truth and made you aware of your duty."

verses.devanagari:
संश्रुत्य शैब्यः श्येनाय स्वाम् तनुम् जगती पतिः |
प्रदाय पक्षिणो राजन् जगाम गतिम् उत्तमाम्
verses.iast:
saṃśrutya śaibyaḥ śyenāya svām tanum jagatī patiḥ |
pradāya pakṣiṇo rājan jagāma gatim uttamām
verses.translation: "Oh, king! Having made a promise to a hawk and offering his body to the bird , king Saibya, the ruler of world obtained the greatest destiny".

verses.devanagari:
तथ हि अलर्कः तेजस्वी ब्राह्मणे वेद पारगे |
याचमाने स्वके नेत्रेउद्ध्ऱ्त्य अविमना ददौ
verses.iast:
tatha hi alarkaḥ tejasvī brāhmaṇe veda pārage |
yācamāne svake netreuddhRtya avimanā dadau
verses.translation: "In that manner, Alarka the glorious man plucking his own eyes, indeed gave remorselessly, to a brahmana skilled in the Veda, When asked for them."

verses.devanagari:
सरिताम् तु पतिः स्वल्पाम् मर्यादाम् सत्यम् अन्वितः |
सत्य अनुरोधात् समये वेलाम् खाम् न अतिवर्तते
verses.iast:
saritām tu patiḥ svalpām maryādām satyam anvitaḥ |
satya anurodhāt samaye velām khām na ativartate
verses.translation: "Following ruthfulness, ocean the lord of rivers even at the time of flow-tide, does not transgress even to a small extent its boundary because of its compliance to truth."

verses.devanagari:
स्त्यमेकपदं ब्रह्मे सत्ये धर्मः प्रतिष्ठतः|
सत्यमेवाक्षया वेदाः सत्येनै वाप्यते परम्
verses.iast:
styamekapadaṃ brahme satye dharmaḥ pratiśhṭhataḥ |
satyamevākśayā vedāḥ satyenai vāpyate param
verses.translation: "Truth is one word and is Brahma. On truth is righteousness established. Truth indeed is the knowledge imperishable. By truth alone, the supreme being is obtained".

verses.devanagari:
सत्यं समनुवर्त्स्व यदि धर्मे धृता मतिः |
सफलः स वरो मेऽस्तु वरदो ह्यसि सत्तम
verses.iast:
satyaṃ samanuvartsva yadi dharme dhṛtā matiḥ |
saphalaḥ sa varo me'stu varado hyasi sattama
verses.translation: "O the best among men! firmly adhere to truth, if your mind is fixed on piety. Since you are a bestower of boons, let my aforesaid prayer be granted.

glosses.meaning: Oh the best of men! matiH dhR^itaayadi = if your mind is fixed

verses.devanagari:
धर्मस्येहाभिकामार्थं मम चैवाचिचोदनात् |
प्रव्राजय सुतं रामम् त्रिः खलु त्वां ब्रवीम्यहम्
verses.iast:
dharmasyehābhikāmārthaṃ mama caivācicodanāt |
pravrājaya sutaṃ rāmam triḥ khalu tvāṃ bravīmyaham
verses.translation: "In the matter, yearning righteousness and to concede to my request, send Rama the son to exile. I am telling to you three times".

verses.devanagari:
समयम् च मम आर्य इमम् यदि त्वम् न करिष्यसि |
अग्रतः ते परित्यक्ता परित्यक्ष्यामि जीवितम्
verses.iast:
samayam ca mama ārya imam yadi tvam na kariṣyasi |
agrataḥ te parityaktā parityakṣyāmi jīvitam
verses.translation: "Oh, the venerable man! If you do not implement our agreement, it means you have abandoned me. Hence I will give up my life here in front of you".

glosses.itrans: the venerable man ! tvam karishhyasi yadi
glosses.iast: the venerable man ! tvam kariśhyasi yadi
glosses.devanagari: थे वेनेरब्ले मन् ! त्वं करिश्ह्यसि यदि

verses.devanagari:
एवम् प्रचोदितः राजा कैकेय्या निर्विशन्कया |
न अशकत् पाशम् उन्मोक्तुम् बलिर् इन्द्र क्ऱ्तम् यथा
verses.iast:
evam pracoditaḥ rājā kaikeyyā nirviśankayā |
na aśakat pāśam unmoktum balir indra kRtam yathā
verses.translation: Thus compelled by Kaikeyi, who had no uneasiness in her mind, king Dasaratha could not untie the cord of plighted word that fettered him , any more than Bali could unloose the noose placed (round his body) by Indra(through his younger brother Vamana in order to deprive him of his sovereignty of the three worlds).

verses.devanagari:
उद्भ्रान्त ह्ऱ्दयः च अपि विवर्ण वनदो अभवत् |
स धुर्यो वै परिस्पन्दन् युग चक्र अन्तरम् यथा
verses.iast:
udbhrānta hRdayaḥ ca api vivarṇa vanado abhavat |
sa dhuryo vai parispandan yuga cakra antaram yathā
verses.translation: Like a bullock throbbing between yoke and the wheel , Dasaratha got agitated in heart and became pale in his face.

verses.devanagari:
विह्वलाभ्याम् च नेत्राभ्याम् अपश्यन्न् इव भूमिपः |
क्ऱ्च्च्रात् धैर्येण संस्तभ्य कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
vihvalābhyām ca netrābhyām apaśyann iva bhūmipaḥ |
kRccrāt dhairyeṇa saṃstabhya kaikeyīm idam abravīt
verses.translation: King Dasaratha, with bedimmed eyes, was unable, as it were, to see. But with difficulty, he controlled himself by recourse to firmness and spoke to Kaikeyi as follows.

verses.devanagari:
यः ते मन्त्र क्ऱ्तः पाणिर् अग्नौ पापे मया ध्ऱ्तः |
तम् त्यजामि स्वजम् चैव तव पुत्रम् सह त्वया
verses.iast:
yaḥ te mantra kRtaḥ pāṇir agnau pāpe mayā dhRtaḥ |
tam tyajāmi svajam caiva tava putram saha tvayā
verses.translation: "Oh, wicked woman! I abandon your hand, which was clasped by me in presence of nuptial fire, when it was consecrated by sacred recitations as also your son begotten by me along with yourself".

glosses.meaning: in the presence of nuptial fire
when it was consecrated by sacred recitations

verses.devanagari:
प्रयाता रजनी देवि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति |
अभिषेकं गुरुजन्स्त्वरयीष्यति मां ध्रुवम्
रामाभिषेकसम्भारैस्तदर्थमुपकल्पितैः |
verses.iast:
prayātā rajanī devi sūryasyodayanaṃ prati |
abhiśhekaṃ gurujanstvarayīśhyati māṃ dhruvam
rāmābhiśhekasambhāraistadarthamupakalpitaiḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, Queen! the night has gone by, with the return pf rising sun. Elderly people will certainly quicken me for installation of Rama with the sacred materials procured for the purpose".

glosses.meaning: with material to be used for Rama's coranation

verses.devanagari:
रामः कारयितव्यो मे मृतस्य सलिलक्रियाम्
त्वया सपुत्त्रया नैव कर्तव्या सलिलक्रिया |
व्याहन्तास्यशुभाचारे यदि रामाभिषेचन्म्
verses.iast:
rāmaḥ kārayitavyo me mṛtasya salilakriyām
tvayā saputtrayā naiva kartavyā salilakriyā |
vyāhantāsyaśubhācāre yadi rāmābhiśhecanm
verses.translation: "Oh, woman of vicious conduct! If you obstruct Rama's installation, you including your son cannot offer me water. Rama will be made to do the offering of water to me, after death.

glosses.itrans: woman of vicious conduct! vyaahantaasi adi
glosses.iast: voman of vicious conduct! vyāhantāsi adi
glosses.devanagari: वोमन् ओf विचिओउस् चोन्दुच्त्! व्याहन्तासि अदि

verses.devanagari:
न च शक्नोम्यहं द्रषुं पूर्वं तथा सुखम् |
हतहर्षं निरानन्दं पुनर्जनमवाङ्मुखम्
verses.iast:
na ca śaknomyahaṃ draśhuṃ pūrvaṃ tathā sukham |
hataharśhaṃ nirānandaṃ punarjanamavāṇ^mukham
verses.translation: "Having seen people with that joy before, I cannot see them with there happiness ended, without any merriment and having their faces turned downward in grief".

verses.devanagari:
तां तथा ब्रुवत्स्तस्य भूमिपन्य महात्मनः |
प्रभाता शर्वरी पुण्या चन्द्रनक्षत्रश्रालिनी
verses.iast:
tāṃ tathā bruvatstasya bhūmipanya mahātmanaḥ |
prabhātā śarvarī puṇyā candranakśatraśrālinī
verses.translation: While that great souled king was speaking to her as aforesaid, the holy night endowed with, moon and stars began to become clear into a dawn.

glosses.meaning: began to become clear into a dawn.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पाप समाचारा कैकेयी पार्थिवम् पुनः |
उवाच परुषम् वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञा रोष मूर्चिता
verses.iast:
tataḥ pāpa samācārā kaikeyī pārthivam punaḥ |
uvāca paruṣam vākyam vākyaGYā roṣa mūrcitā
verses.translation: Kaikeyi of vicious conduct and of skilful talk, filled with anger again spoke these harsh words to the king.

verses.devanagari:
किम् इदम् भाषसे राजन् वाक्यम् गर रुज उपमम् |
आनाययितुम् अक्लिष्टम् पुत्रम् रामम् इह अर्हसि
verses.iast:
kim idam bhāṣase rājan vākyam gara ruja upamam |
ānāyayitum akliṣṭam putram rāmam iha arhasi
verses.translation: " Oh, king ! You are uttering words, which cannot be swallowed easily like in a painful throat disease. You ought to summon your son Rama here without any delay."

glosses.meaning: why is this? arhasi = you ought

verses.devanagari:
स्थाप्य राज्ये मम सुतम् क्ऱ्त्वा रामम् वने चरम् |
निह्सपत्नाम् च माम् क्ऱ्त्वा क्ऱ्त क्ऱ्त्यो भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
sthāpya rājye mama sutam kRtvā rāmam vane caram |
nihsapatnām ca mām kRtvā kRta kRtyo bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "You will be the one who discharges duty, by installing my son to this kingdom, by making Rama to wander in woods and rid me of enemies."

glosses.meaning: You will be one who discharged duty

verses.devanagari:
स नुन्नैव तीक्षेन प्रतोदेन हय उत्तमः |
राजा प्रदोचितः अभीक्ष्णम् कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa nunnaiva tīkṣena pratodena haya uttamaḥ |
rājā pradocitaḥ abhīkṣṇam kaikeyīm idam abravīt
verses.translation: Impelled again and again by Kaikeyi, like an excellent horse being severely thrashed with a whip, that king spoke these words to Kaikeyi.

verses.devanagari:
धर्म बन्धेन बद्धो अस्मि नष्टा च मम चेतना |
ज्येष्ठम् पुत्रम् प्रियम् रामम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चामि धार्मिकम्
verses.iast:
dharma bandhena baddho asmi naṣṭā ca mama cetanā |
jyeṣṭham putram priyam rāmam draṣṭum iccāmi dhārmikam
verses.translation: "I am bound by the ties of morality. I lost my judgement. I wish to see the pious Rama, my beloved elder son."

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रभातां र्जनीमुदिते च दिवाकरे |
पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे चे मुहूर्ते च समाहिते
वसिष्ठो गुणसंपन्नः शिष्येः परिवृतस्तदा |
उपगृह्याशु संभारान् [रविवेश पुरोत्तमम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ prabhātāṃ rjanīmudite ca divākare |
puṇye nakśatrayoge ce muhūrte ca samāhite
vasiśhṭho guṇasampannaḥ śiśhyeḥ parivṛtastadā |
upagṛhyāśu sambhārān [raviveśa purottamam
verses.translation: Meanwhile, the night began to become clear, with the rising of sun. While the auspicious, moment united with lunar mansion approaching, the sage Vashishta who is rich in virtues surrounded by his disciples entered the capital city of Ayodhya briskly, having procured the requisite materials for Rama's coronation.

verses.devanagari:
सिक्तसंमार्जितपथां पताकोत्तमभूषिताम् |
विचित्रकुसुमाकीर्णां नानास्रग्भिर्विराजिताम्
संहृष्टमनुजोपेतां समृद्धविपणापणाम् |
महोत्सवसमाकीर्णां राघवार्थे समुस्त्सुकाम्
चन्दनागुरुधूपैश्च सर्वतः प्रतिधूपिताम् |
तां पुरीम् समतिक्रम्य पुरन्दरपुरोपमाम्
ददर्शान्तः पुरश्रेष्ठं नानाद्विजगणायुतम् |
पौरजानपदाकिर्र्र्णं ब्राह्मणैरुपशोभितम्
verses.iast:
siktasaṃmārjitapathāṃ patākottamabhūśhitām |
vicitrakusumākīrṇāṃ nānāsragbhirvirājitām
saṃhṛśhṭamanujopetāṃ samṛddhavipaṇāpaṇām |
mahotsavasamākīrṇāṃ rāghavārthe samustsukām
candanāgurudhūpaiśca sarvataḥ pratidhūpitām |
tāṃ purīm samatikramya purandarapuropamām
dadarśāntaḥ puraśreśhṭhaṃ nānādvijagaṇāyutam |
paurajānapadākirrrṇaṃ brāhmaṇairupaśobhitam
verses.translation: Passing through that city, whose streets were swept and watered decorated with , excellent flags, overspread with colourful flowers , made brilliant with various types of garlands, filled with people of joy, with shops and markets with abundance, filled with lot of festivities, anxiously waiting for Rama, fumigated on all sides with perfumes of sandalwood , also resembling Amaravathy city(capital of Indra); the sage Vashishta beheld the excellent, gynaecium filled with many a number of brahmanas, crowded with citizens and countrymen, looking splendorous with brahmanas, knowers of sacrificial assembly filled with excellent brahmanas.

glosses.meaning: whose streets were swept and watered
with shops and markets in abundance
by perfumes of sandalwood and aloc
filled with many number of brahmanas
crowded with citizens and country men

verses.devanagari:
तदन्तः पुरमासाद्य व्यतिचक्राम तम् जनम्
वसिष्ठः परमप्रीतः परमर्षिर्विवेश च |
verses.iast:
tadantaḥ puramāsādya vyaticakrāma tam janam
vasiśhṭhaḥ paramaprītaḥ paramarśhirviveśa ca |
verses.translation: Sage Vashishta, being well pleased of seeing that gynaecium, got past those people there and , entered it.

verses.devanagari:
स त्वपश्यद्विनिष्क्रान्तं सुमन्त्रं नाम सारथिम् |
द्वारे मनुजसिंहस्य सचिवं प्रियदर्शन्म्
verses.iast:
sa tvapaśyadviniśhkrāntaṃ sumantraṃ nāma sārathim |
dvāre manujasiṃhasya sacivaṃ priyadarśanm
verses.translation: Meanwhile, Vashishta saw Sumantra by name, who was charioteer-cum-minister of Dasaratha and who had a pleasing appearance coming out of the royal gate.

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच महातेजाः सूतपुत्रं विशारदम्
वसिष्ठः क्षिप्रमाचक्ष्व नृपते र्मामिहागतम् |
verses.iast:
tamuvāca mahātejāḥ sūtaputraṃ viśāradam
vasiśhṭhaḥ kśipramācakśva nṛpate rmāmihāgatam |
verses.translation: That great splendoured Vashishta spoke thus to the learned Sumantra, "Tell the king quickly, that I have come."
notes: The word "suta" evidently denotes here the son of a kshatriya through a brahmana wife (his business being that of a bard or a charioteer)-Amarakosa.

verses.devanagari:
इमे गङ्गोदकघटाः सागरेभ्यश्च काञ्चनाः
औदुम्बरं भद्रपीठमभिषेकार्थमागतम् |
सर्वबीजानि गन्धाश्च रत्नानि विविधानि च
क्षौद्रम् दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भाः सुमनसः पयः |
अष्टौ च कन्या रुचिरा मत्तश्छ वरवारणः |
चतुरश्वो रथः श्रीमान् निस्त्रिंशो धनुरुत्तमम् |
वाहनं नरसंयुक्तं चत्रं च शशिपन्निभम्
श्वेते च वालव्यजने भृङ्गारुश्छ हिरण्मयः |
हेमदामपिनद्धश्च किकुद्मान् पाण्डुरो वृषः
केसरी च चतुर्दंष्ट्रो हि श्रेष्ठो महाबलः |
सिंहानस्नं व्याघ्रतनुः समिद्धश्छ हुताशनः
सर्ववादित्रसंघाश्च वेश्याश्छालंकृताः स्त्रियः |
आचार्या ब्राह्मणा गावः पुण्यश्च मृगपक्षिणः
पौरजानपदश्रेष्ठा नैगमाश्च गणैः सह |
एते चान्ये च बहवो नीयमानाः प्रियम्वदाः
अभिषेकाय रामस्य सह तिष्ठन्ति पार्थिवैः |
verses.iast:
ime gaṇ^godakaghaṭāḥ sāgarebhyaśca kāJṇcanāḥ
audumbaraṃ bhadrapīṭhamabhiśhekārthamāgatam |
sarvabījāni gandhāśca ratnāni vividhāni ca
kśaudram dadhi ghṛtaṃ lājā darbhāḥ sumanasaḥ payaḥ |
aśhṭau ca kanyā rucirā mattaścha varavāraṇaḥ |
caturaśvo rathaḥ śrīmān nistriṃśo dhanuruttamam |
vāhanaṃ narasaṃyuktaṃ catraṃ ca śaśipannibham
śvete ca vālavyajane bhṛṇ^gāruścha hiraṇmayaḥ |
hemadāmapinaddhaśca kikudmān pāṇḍuro vṛśhaḥ
kesarī ca caturdaṃśhṭro hi śreśhṭho mahābalaḥ |
siṃhānasnaṃ vyāghratanuḥ samiddhaścha hutāśanaḥ
sarvavāditrasaṅghāśca veśyāśchālaṅkṛtāḥ striyaḥ |
ācāryā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ puṇyaśca mṛgapakśiṇaḥ
paurajānapadaśreśhṭhā naigamāśca gaṇaiḥ saha |
ete cānye ca bahavo nīyamānāḥ priyamvadāḥ
abhiśhekāya rāmasya saha tiśhṭhanti pārthivaiḥ |
verses.translation: "These pitchers filled with holy waters of ganga , gold pitchers with sea water and an excellent seat with Udambara wood came for the purpose of Rama's installation ceremony. All types of seeds, fragrant substances and precious stones of various kinds, honey, curd, clarified butter, parched grains of paddy, blades of Darbha grass, flowers, milk, eight beautiful virgins , an elephant in rut, a glorious chariot with four horses, a special kind of sword called Nistrimsa, an excellent bow , a palanquin with bearers an umbrella resembling the moon , a pair of white chowries, a golden jug, a white bull with large , humo on its back, an excellent lion with beautiful mane with large canine teeth, a throne, a tiger skin, fire with ignition , all varieties of musical instruments,courtesans, women decked with ornaments, teachers, brahmanas, cows, animals and birds which are sacred, the best of citizens and men of country side, merchants along with their followers, all these and many other retainers speaking kind words, along with kings stand waiting for Rama's coronation.

glosses.meaning: pitchers filled with holy waters of Ganga
for the purpose of Rama's coronation
with large hump on its back
a throne(with a pair of lions made of the same material for its charm)
the best of citizens and men of country-side

verses.devanagari:
त्वरयस्व महाराजं यथा समुदितेऽहनि
पुण्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात् |
verses.iast:
tvarayasva mahārājaṃ yathā samudite'hani
puṇye nakśatrayoge ca rāmo rājyamavāpnuyāt |
verses.translation: Hasten the emperor, so that Rama will get the throne when the day gets started at the auspicious moment of pushya constellation uniting with the moon"

verses.devanagari:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रो महात्मनः
स्तुवन्नृपतिशार्धूलं प्रविवेश निवेशनम् |
verses.iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sūtaputro mahātmanaḥ
stuvannṛpatiśārdhūlaṃ praviveśa niveśanam |
verses.translation: Hearing these words Vashishta the great souled, Sumantra entered the gynaecium along with Dasaratha, the tiger among kings.

verses.devanagari:
तं तु पूर्वोदितं वृद्धं द्वारस्था राजसम्मतम्
न शेकुरभिसंरोद्धुं राज्ञः प्रयचिकीर्ष्वः |
verses.iast:
taṃ tu pūrvoditaṃ vṛddhaṃ dvārasthā rājasammatam
na śekurabhisaṃroddhuṃ rājJṇḥ prayacikīrśhvaḥ |
verses.translation: The doormen , who were wishing to do kindness to king, could not obstruct Sumantra, who came before hand who was senior and who was highly esteemed by the king.

glosses.meaning: who were wishing to do kindness
who was esteemed by the king.

verses.devanagari:
स सवीपस्थितो राज्ञ्स्तामवस्थामजज्ञीवान्
वाग्भिः परमतुष्टाभिरभिष्टोतुं प्रचक्रमे |
verses.iast:
sa savīpasthito rājJṇstāmavasthāmajajJṇīvān
vāgbhiḥ paramatuśhṭābhirabhiśhṭotuṃ pracakrame |
verses.translation: Standing besides the king and ignorant of that situation, Sumantra started praising the king with very pleasing words.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सूतो यथाकालं पार्थिवस्य निवेशने
सुमन्त्रः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तुष्टाव जगतीपतिम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sūto yathākālaṃ pārthivasya niveśane
sumantraḥ prāJṇjalirbhūtvā tuśhṭāva jagatīpatim |
verses.translation: Sumantra, standing with joined palms in the gynaecium of the king, eulogised the king according to the appropriate moment as follows.

verses.devanagari:
यथा नन्दति तेजस्वी सागरो भास्करोदये |
प्रीतह् प्रीतेन मनसा तथानन्दघनः स्वतः
verses.iast:
yathā nandati tejasvī sāgaro bhāskarodaye |
prītah prītena manasā tathānandaghanaḥ svataḥ
verses.translation: "How the splendid ocean gladdens at the time of sunrise, so do you by nature filled with delight, gladden us with your delighted mind."

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रमस्यां तु वेळायामभितुष्टाव मातलिः
सोऽजयद्धानवान्सर्वांस्तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम् |
verses.iast:
indramasyāṃ tu veLāyāmabhituśhṭāva mātaliḥ
so'jayaddhānavānsarvāṃstathā tvāṃ bodhayāmyaham |
verses.translation: "At the very hour of sunrise, Matali (Indra's charioteer)praised Indra and the latter conquered all the demons. In the same manner, I am awakening you."

verses.devanagari:
वेदाः सहाङ्गविद्याश्छ यथाह्यात्मभुवम् विभुम्
ब्रह्माणम् बोधयन्त्यद्य तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम् |
verses.iast:
vedāḥ sahāṇ^gavidyāścha yathāhyātmabhuvam vibhum
brahmāṇam bodhayantyadya tathā tvāṃ bodhayāmyaham |
verses.translation: "As Vedas along with the knowledge of the limbs of the body guide Lord Brahma (the creator) who is self born, so am I awakening you now."
notes: Brahma derives his knowledge of objects to be evolved at the beginning of creation from the Vedas.

glosses.meaning: along with the knowledge of limbs of the body

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यः सह चन्द्रेण यथा भूतधरां शुभाम्
बोधयत्यद्य पृथिवीं तथा त्वाम् बोधयाम्यहम् |
verses.iast:
ādityaḥ saha candreṇa yathā bhūtadharāṃ śubhām
bodhayatyadya pṛthivīṃ tathā tvām bodhayāmyaham |
verses.translation: "Even as the sun along with the moon awaken the beautiful earth which sustains the beings so, am I awakening you."

verses.devanagari:
उत्तिष्ठाशु महाराज कृतकौतुकमङ्गळः
विराजमानो वपुषा मेरोरिव दिवाकरः |
verses.iast:
uttiśhṭhāśu mahārāja kṛtakautukamaṇ^gaLaḥ
virājamāno vapuśhā meroriva divākaraḥ |
verses.translation: "Having dressed suitably for the auspicious ceremony and shining brightly with you personality, raise up. Oh, Majesty, like the sun from mount Meru."

glosses.meaning: and dressed suitably for the auspicious ceremony.

verses.devanagari:
सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्थ्स शिववैश्रवणावपि
वरुणाश्छग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिश्न्तु ते |
verses.iast:
somasūryau ca kākutthsa śivavaiśravaṇāvapi
varuṇāśchagnirindraśca vijayaṃ pradiśntu te |
verses.translation: "Oh, Dasaratha born in Kakutsa dynasty! May the Gods -Sun and the Moon Shiva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra bestow you victory!"

glosses.itrans: Dasarath a born in kakutsa dynasty! soma suuryoncha
glosses.iast: ḍasarath a born in kakutsa dynasty! soma sūryonca
glosses.devanagari: डसरथ् अ बोर्न् इन् ककुत्स द्य्नस्त्य्! सोम सूर्योन्च

verses.devanagari:
गता भगवती रात्रिः कृतकृत्य मिदं तव
बुद्ध्यस्व सृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम् |
उदतिष्ठत रामस्य समग्रमभिषेचन्म्
verses.iast:
gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ kṛtakṛtya midaṃ tava
buddhyasva sṛpaśārdūla kuru kāryamanantaram |
udatiśhṭhata rāmasya samagramabhiśhecanm
verses.translation: "Oh, the best of the kings ! The holy night has gone by. Know what has been done and do what has to be done. All the requirements for Rama's coronation is kept ready" .

verses.devanagari:
पौरजानपदैश्चापि नैगमैश्च कृताञ्जलिः |
स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ब्राह्मणैः सह तिष्ठति
verses.iast:
paurajānapadaiścāpi naigamaiśca kṛtāJṇjaliḥ |
svayaṃ vasiśhṭho bhagavān brāhmaṇaiḥ saha tiśhṭhati
verses.translation: "The venerable Vashishta himself stands waiting at the gate along with brahmanas, being saluted saluted with joined palms by citizens, village folk and merchants."

glosses.meaning: being saluted with joined palms by

verses.devanagari:
क्षिप्रमाज्ञ्प्यतां राजन् राघवस्याभिषेचन्म् |
यथा ह्यपालाः पशवो यथा सेना ह्यानायका
यथा च्न्द्रं विना रात्रिर्यथा गावो विना वृषम् |
एवं हि भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र राजा न दृश्यते
verses.iast:
kśipramājJṇpyatāṃ rājan rāghavasyābhiśhecanm |
yathā hyapālāḥ paśavo yathā senā hyānāyakā
yathā cndraṃ vinā rātriryathā gāvo vinā vṛśham |
evaṃ hi bhavitā rāśhṭraṃ yatra rājā na dṛśyate
verses.translation: "Oh king! Give orders quickly for Rama's coronation ceremony. A kingdom without a king is like cattle without a herdsman, army without a commander, night without the moon and cows without a bull."

verses.devanagari:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमिवार्थवत् |
अभ्यकीर्यत शोकेन भूय एव महीपतिः
verses.iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sāntvapūrvamivārthavat |
abhyakīryata śokena bhūya eva mahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: King Dasaratha hearing his words which were soothing and meaningful, was surrounded with grief once more.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स राजा तम् सूतम् सन्न हर्षः सुतम् प्रति |
शोक आरक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उद्वीक्ष्य उवाच धार्मिकः || २-१४
वाक्यैस्तु खलु मर्माणि मम भूयो निकृन्तसि |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa rājā tam sūtam sanna harṣaḥ sutam prati |
śoka ārakta īkṣaṇaḥ śrīmān udvīkṣya uvāca dhārmikaḥ || 2-14
vākyaistu khalu marmāṇi mama bhūyo nikṛntasi |
verses.translation: That king who was pious and glorious, having lost joy about his son, looked up with sorrowful red eyes and spoke those to Sumantra. "You are chopping off my vitals further more, with your words!."

verses.devanagari:
सुमन्त्रः करुणम् श्रुत्वा द्ऱ्ष्ट्वा दीनम् च पार्थिवम्
प्रग्ऱ्हीत अन्जलिः किंचित् तस्मात् देशात् अपाक्रमन् |
verses.iast:
sumantraḥ karuṇam śrutvā dRṣṭvā dīnam ca pārthivam
pragRhīta anjaliḥ kiṃcit tasmāt deśāt apākraman |
verses.translation: Sumantra, after seeing the depressed king and hearing mournful words, joined palms with salutation and slipped away to a distance from that place.

glosses.meaning: taken upon himself the joined palms

verses.devanagari:
यदा वक्तुम् स्वयम् दैन्यान् न शशाक मही पतिः
तदा सुमन्त्रम् मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह |
verses.iast:
yadā vaktum svayam dainyān na śaśāka mahī patiḥ
tadā sumantram mantraGYā kaikeyī pratyuvāca ha |
verses.translation: Dasaratha could not say any thing himself because of depression. Then, Kaikeyi who is experienced in fore-thoughts, spoke thus to Sumantra.

verses.devanagari:
सुमन्त्र राजा रजनीं रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः
प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तो निद्रावशमुपेयुवान् |
verses.iast:
sumantra rājā rajanīṃ rāmaharśhasamutsukaḥ
prajāgarapariśrānto nidrāvaśamupeyuvān |
verses.translation: "Oh Sumantra! The king, being smitten by emotional joy in relation to Rama, who tired of awakening the whole night and got subjected to sleep"

glosses.meaning: getting emotional by the joy related to Rama

verses.devanagari:
तद्गच्छ त्वरितं सूत राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्
राममानय भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा |
verses.iast:
tadgaccha tvaritaṃ sūta rājaputraṃ yaśasvinam
rāmamānaya bhadraṃ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! Hence, quickly go and bring the glorious prince Rama. Blessedness to you! Do not have any hesitation in this matter. "

verses.devanagari:
स मन्यमानः कल्याणम् हृदयेन नन्नन्ध च
निर्जगाम च संप्रीत्या त्वरितो राजशासनात् |
verses.iast:
sa manyamānaḥ kalyāṇam hṛdayena nannandha ca
nirjagāma ca samprītyā tvarito rājaśāsanāt |
verses.translation: "He was thinking of that auspicious occasion in heart and rejoiced. With pleasure, he set out, by the orders of the king."

glosses.meaning: by the orders of the king.

verses.devanagari:
सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास त्वरितं चोदितस्तया
व्यक्तं रामोऽभिषेकार्थमिहायास्यति धर्मवित् |
verses.iast:
sumantraścintayāmāsa tvaritaṃ coditastayā
vyaktaṃ rāmo'bhiśhekārthamihāyāsyati dharmavit |
verses.translation: Instigated by her, Sumantra thought that the righteous Rama would come there certainly for coronation.

verses.devanagari:
इति सूतो मतिं कृत्वा हर्षेण महता वृतः
निर्जगाम महाबाहो राघवस्य दिदृक्षया |
verses.iast:
iti sūto matiṃ kṛtvā harśheṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ
nirjagāma mahābāho rāghavasya didṛkśayā |
verses.translation: Sumantra thus thinking and dwelling in a great joy, set out with a desire to see the long armed Rama

verses.devanagari:
सागरह्रदसंकाशात्सुमन्त्रोऽन्तःपुराच्छुभात्
निष्क्रम्य जनसंबाधं ददर्श द्वारमग्रतः |
verses.iast:
sāgarahradasaṅkāśātsumantro'ntaḥpurācchubhāt
niśhkramya janasambādhaṃ dadarśa dvāramagrataḥ |
verses.translation: Sumantra coming out of gynaceumwhich looked like a splendid pool in the sea, saw the gate being congested with throngs of people.

glosses.meaning: like a pool in the sea

verses.devanagari:
ततः पुरस्तत्सासा विनिर्गतो |
महीपतीन् द्वारगतो विलोकयन् |
ददर्श पौरान् विविधान्महाधना |
नुपस्थितान् द्वारमुपेत्य विष्ठतान्
verses.iast:
tataḥ purastatsāsā vinirgato |
mahīpatīn dvāragato vilokayan |
dadarśa paurān vividhānmahādhanā |
nupasthitān dvāramupetya viśhṭhatān
verses.translation: Afterwards, proceeding further on, he saw near the gate some kings stationed there and very rich citizens having arrived there.
